title: Selected Topics in History; Trashed! Garbage and Recycling in History
description: Students will explore how humans have produced, dealt with, and ignored trash and recycling in history. Case studies from North America, Europe, and Asia from the 19th and 20th century will help us understand how the role of garbage in society has changed over time. The emphasis will be on the wider social, political, environmental, and material systems that shape waste.
